# Mosaic Hostel Varanasi

> Premium budget hostel near Assi Ghat in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Established 2025. Dorm beds from ₹499/night and private rooms from ₹1,500/night. Welcomes solo travellers, backpackers, groups and families seeking an authentic stay in one of the world's oldest cities.

## Location & Contact

- **Address:** B1/85C, Assi Ghat Road, Anandbagh, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221005, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-9125492225
- **Email:** mosaichostels@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.mosaichostels.com
- **Coordinates:** 25.28726, 83.00316 (steps from Assi Ghat)

## Rooms & Rates

- **Dorms** — 6-bed mixed, 6-bed female-only, 4-bed female-only. From ₹499/night.
- **Private rooms** — single, double and triple occupancy, AC, ensuite bathroom. From ₹1,500/night.
- Check-in from 1:00 PM, check-out by 10:30 AM, 24-hour reception.

## Amenities

Free high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, hot-water showers, lockers, shared kitchen, rooftop space, 24-hour check-in.
